title: Zesty Crispy Saudi Arabian Fish Skillet
description: A buttery and crispy Saudi Arabian dish featuring fish stock and ferment kimchi, perfect for a crowd, made with whole30 friendly ingredients and cooked on a tava griddle.
instructions: Heat the tava griddle over medium heat and add the ghee.
Add the garlic and saute for 1 minute until fragrant.
Add the cod fish pieces and cook for 3 minutes on each side until golden brown.
Add the fish stock, ferment kimchi, lemon juice, salt, and black pepper, and stir well.
Bring the mixture to a simmer and cook for 5 minutes until the fish is cooked through.
Serve the fish skillet hot, garnished with chopped fresh parsley.
Cook the fish skillet for an additional 2 minutes if the fish is not cooked through.
Remove the skillet from the heat and let it cool for 1 minute before serving.
